state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`: Stages 6 and 7 are on disk; Stage 8 is in progress.** ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

Stage 8 on disk: the `php-migration/` topic is dissolved, `divergesFromPhp` and `docs/divergences.md` are gone, and the ten normative lines state the behaviour. The testing rules no longer name the oracle (`ide/case-files-have-their-own-grammar` had no PHP left to cut). Every `php`-tagged fence under `docs/rules/` is now `nvs` — all of them held Novis code. The `classes` topic carries no PHP mention.

Stage 8 still owes the incidental-mention sweep in the other topics (goal prose § *Stage 8*, `docs/agent/goals/php-oracle-retired.md:284`): `git grep -c -w -i php -- 'docs/rules/*/*.md'` lists about 133 files, far more than the prose's estimate of 35. A mention stays where the rule is a diagnostic for a PHP habit (E0229, `<?php`, the superglobals), the benchmarks, or `programs/no-compatibility-promise`; everywhere else the sentence is rewritten to state the behaviour. No check pins this, so it is judgment work, one topic per slice.

The Stage 9 checks the driver reports red are not written yet; they follow Stage 8.

items.text: **Incidental PHP mentions leave the `core-api` topic** — goal prose § *Stage 8*; `docs/rules/core-api/reference-card.md:1`, listed by `git grep -n -w -i php -- 'docs/rules/core-api/*.md'` (22 files).
**The same for `core-classes`, `ide`, `tooling` and `packaging`** — `docs/rules/packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed.md:8` (the goal prose's own example); then the small topics.

backlog: `classes/property-hooks.md` once said hooks keep asymmetric visibility's interaction; no conformance case pins a hooked property with `private(set)`, so the line was cut rather than restated — a case would let the rule say it (`rule:classes/property-hooks`).
Stage 9 follows Stage 8: `about.md`, registry text, website, the concept page (goal prose § *Stage 9*).
